items: The update button is back in the bottom-left corner, next to the version number.
Launcher shows your 9 most recent FL Studio projects under the DAWs. Click one to open it; See all opens the FL Studio screen.
The Projects button is back on the FL Studio tile.

Mods: put mods in Documents › Compass › Mods and turn them on in Settings › Mods. A mod can restyle the app and add song or project menu items, react to what is playing, and control the player. It runs in a sandbox and can never touch the Music Store or Marketplace. Open the folder once to get an example mod.
Launcher: right-click a DAW to pick which installed version to open (for example FL Studio 21 or 2024). Open remembers the one you picked.

FL Studio screen redesigned: one row of tabs (Recent, All projects, Zipped loops, Backups), one toolbar (search, sort, and a folder filter only when you have more than one folder), and a compact one-line list. Folders and the backup folder are managed from one Folders button. Right-click a project to show it in its folder.
Backups tab: FL Studio's own autosaves (Projects › Backup), or a backup folder you choose.

Features: a small button next to Details & credits. Type @ and a name to tag an artist. Each one can be in the title (feat.), under the title, or not named. Their info (legal name, role, PRO, IPI, publisher, publishing email) is saved once and fills in on every song you feature them on. Nothing is required.
Deleting a version asks first.
Previous restarts the song when you are more than 3 seconds in. On the first song it restarts that song instead of jumping to the end (unless Repeat all is on).
Song panel is shorter: tags, features, the preview and the project checklist are gone (features live in Details & credits; Add to / Move to are in the song menu). Status, BPM and key sit on one row.
Export song info: one song from its panel (Export info), or every song in a project from Share & export (Export song info). Saves a .txt with credits, BPM, key, ISRC, lyrics and more.
Cleaner, less cluttered app. Buttons that did the same thing are merged:
Library: one Add music button (it takes .zip downloads too). Scan QR is a small icon. The sidebar footer is just credits and the version (click it to check for updates).
Project page: the header is Play, Add songs, Share and ⋯. Rename and Edit details are one item. A song's ⋯ opens the same menu as right-click, starting with Edit song.
CD Creator: one Export menu (print files, 3D model, picture). One Viewer button. Opacity, fill and text options each live in one place instead of two or three.
Settings: Desktop app and About are one row. The EQ lives in the player bar only. CD Creator shortcuts are tucked under their own heading.
Menus use the same capitalisation everywhere, and the nav icons are all different.

FL Studio screen: a separate Zipped loop projects tab lists FL zipped loop packages (.zip files with a project inside) from your project folders and Downloads. Click one to open it in FL Studio. Open other project… accepts them too.
More space between songs in disc lists. Each song is still one line.

FL Studio screen: All projects lists every project in your project folders, 12 per page with numbered pages. Search by name or folder, sort (recently saved, oldest, A–Z, Z–A, largest) and filter by folder or when it was saved.
Removed the Concept player. Your artist name and verified setting stay in Settings.

Launcher: click FL Studio (or Projects) to see your 6 most recent FL projects and open one straight into FL Studio. Open other project… picks any .flp from your files, and you can add the folders where you keep projects.
Text no longer highlights when you click or drag around the app. Typing fields still work as normal.
QR scanner finds cameras more reliably: it lists every camera Windows reports, and tries each one if the default fails.
When the camera can't start, it says why (blocked by Windows, busy in another app, or none found), with a button to open Windows camera settings.

CD Creator: Update tracklist rewrites the tracklist text on the tray card and booklet from the project's current songs, with disc headings for multi-disc projects. Fonts, colours and positions stay; credits and © lines are kept. Undo works.
Renaming discs works: double-click a disc name, or use Rename Disc in its menu, type, and press Enter. Clear the name to go back to "Disc 1".
Renaming CD designs works in the Windows app too.
Disc lists are compact (one line per song), so a whole disc fits on screen without scrolling.
Scan QR in the Library: scan the code on the back of an album to add it. For now any code unlocks sxteen ways – Movie. Pick which camera to use, or scan from a photo.
Make deluxe: copies a project and adds a Deluxe disc. It sits above New sequel.
Discs now sit side by side. Drag songs between discs, onto a song or anywhere in a disc.
Selected songs no longer squash their rows.
Menus fit on screen and scroll when long. Icons line up.
Removed the Audio Editor. Tempo and key are still read in the background and shown on songs.
Digital albums can be deleted (they go to Recently deleted).
Projects you turned into digital albums or put in the Store stay in the CD Creator.
Faster page switches: smaller cover images in grids and quicker animations.
Click a CD in the Store to see it spinning in 3D, preview any song for 30 seconds, and find the Buy button.
Repeat now cycles: off, repeat album, repeat one song. The CD Player plays the whole album instead of looping one song.
Audio Editor leaves out songs from digital albums until you make your own version of the album.
Logo: only the record turns now, slowly. No more spinning or speeding up on hover.
Logo centered, tonearm moved to the top right, and a thin rim so it shows on dark backgrounds.
Simpler logo.
New projects use your artist name from Settings › Profile.
New logo: a compass record on a turntable with a red tonearm.
Convert to Digital Album is back in the right-click menu. Converted albums move to Library › Digital Albums and are read-only.
Library counts match the tab you are on.
Folders, digital albums and archived projects no longer count as projects.
The Library badge shows your project count.
Right-clicking a digital album shows only Make My Version and Put in the Store, plus Make Sequel when the album is by your own artist name (Settings › Profile).
